SESSIONS.description: KV namespace for Telegram sessions. Created automatically.

DB.description: D1 database for the donation application. Created automatically.

JAMI_PRODUCT_ID.description: Enter your own Jami product ID.

START_IMAGE_URL.description: Optional public image URL for the /start message. Leave empty to use the bundled sticker.

TELEGRAM_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.description: BotFather → Login Widget → Client ID. Enables the /admin dashboard.

ADMIN_TELEGRAM_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram user ids allowed to open /admin. Leave empty to disable dashboard access.

ADMIN_BASE_URL.description: Optional public origin for the dashboard, used to build the OIDC redirect URI when it differs from the request host.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Keep this secret.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Your Telegram webhook secret token. Keep this secret.

TELEGRAM_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.description: BotFather → Login Widget → Client Secret. Keep this secret.

ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional long random string used to sign admin sessions. Falls back to the OIDC client secret.

JAMI_TOKEN.description: Your Jami API token. Keep this secret.

JAMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Your Jami webhook secret token. Keep this secret.

ADMIN_SECRET.description: Your admin secret token for /admin/reconcile. Keep this secret.
